technique_name: Describe the challenges facing the given industry in 4 sentences.
description: The retail industry is facing the challenge of keeping up with changing technology and customer preferences. Consumers expect faster delivery times and a seamless online shopping experience. Retail stores also need to stay on top of new trends and try to differentiate themselves to stay competitive, especially in a market where online retailers are growing rapidly. Retailers also need to be mindful of market fluctuations that can affect their bottom line, and manage their inventory accordingly.
